name: tusk-php
description: High-performance PHP 8.5+ language server with Laravel & Symfony container-aware intelligence

tuskPhpLsp.enable.description: Enable/disable the Tusk PHP LSP extension

tuskPhpLsp.executablePath.description: Custom path to the tusk-php binary

tuskPhpLsp.framework.description: Framework to use for container-aware intelligence

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.phpstan.path.description: Custom path to PHPStan binary (auto-detects vendor/bin/phpstan)

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.phpstan.level.description: PHPStan analysis level (uses project config if empty)

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.phpstan.configPat.description: Custom path to phpstan.neon config file

tuskPhpLsp.coverage.reportPath.description: Path to the Clover coverage report, absolute or relative to the workspace. Empty looks in phpunit.xml and common locations. Tusk PHP reads this report and never runs your tests.

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.pint.enable.description: Enable Laravel Pint analysis on save

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.pint.path.description: Custom path to Pint binary (auto-detects vendor/bin/pint)

tuskPhpLsp.diagnostics.pint.configPath.description: Custom path to pint.json config file

tuskPhpLsp.maxIndexFiles.markdownDescription: Maximum number of workspace PHP files to index. `0` indexes all of them. Set a limit only if the server uses too much memory: all of Magento 2 (about 25,000 files) takes about 600 MB. Composer dependencies aren't counted. In the browser (vscode.dev), the server uses 10,000 unless you set this.

tuskPhpLsp.phpManual.locale.description: Locale for php.net manual links shown in hover and opened via Cmd+Click. Empty falls back to English.

tuskPhpLsp.phpManual.openOnDefinition.description: When enabled, Cmd+Click (Go to Definition) on a built-in PHP symbol opens its page on php.net in your browser instead of doing nothing. Requires the editor to support window/showDocument (VS Code does).

tuskPhpLsp.composer.hover.enable.description: Show hover cards on package keys in composer.json require/require-dev (name, PHP requirement, installed version, source URL).

tuskPhpLsp.composer.openOnDefinition.description: When enabled, Cmd+Click (Go to Definition) on a package name in composer.json opens the package's Packagist (or repository) page in your browser. Requires the editor to support window/showDocument (VS Code does).

enumDescriptions: use App\Models\User as UserModel; and insert UserModel
use App\Models\User as ModelUser; and insert ModelUser
tuskPhpLsp.autoImport.aliasStyle.markdownDescription: How class completion imports a class whose short name is already in use in the file, by another import, a class declared in the file or a class in its namespace. Unset, `.tusk-php.json` decides, then `suffix`.

scripts.package: bun run bundle -- --minify && bun run bundle:web -- --minify && bun x @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies
